minor.endpoint: app.include_router(api_router) called twice (server.py L357 and L775)
minor.issue: The api_router is mounted twice — once before chat routes are attached and once after. FastAPI silently ignores duplicate routes on the same app, but this pattern is fragile: any future route added between the two include_router calls will be registered twice (duplicated in the OpenAPI schema and can trigger 'Duplicate Operation ID' warnings). Recommend removing the first include_router at L357 and only mounting after all routes are declared. Not causing any functional failure right now.

FastAPI middlewares should be added BEFORE the app starts serving; adding them after routes are mounted works today but is not the documented order. Move CORSMiddleware.add_middleware to run right after `app = FastAPI(...)`.

critical_code_review_comments: Chat backend is fully async (motor + FastAPI WebSocket), uses uuid for message ids, no _id leakage from Mongo (chat_messages docs use a separate 'id' field, and chat_conversations uses conversation_id as the _id but list_conversations projects it out as 'conversation_id' via c.get('_id')).
ConnectionManager correctly closes previous socket on reconnect for the same user_id — good for reloads.
Auto-reply is single-flight per conversation (_auto_reply_tasks dict + prev.cancel()) — prevents thundering-herd of Claude calls.

Persona prompts (doctor/service/admin/patient) are language-adaptive: 'Reply in the same language as the patient (English, Russian, or Uzbek)'. Verified in Live test — English question → English reply.
Claude reply length is capped to 600 chars with a graceful ellipsis + word-boundary trim (server.py:508-509). Good.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL consistently (chat store subscribes to ws:// or wss:// derived from it).

Unread badge on patient home chat icon requires the ChatProvider to be listening at app-root even when the user is not on the /chat/* screen. Please confirm the socket is opened in _layout.tsx so unread counters increment while the user is on the home tab. (Not verified in this pass — would require a two-tab test.)
